subject: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@horizonxlabs.com
Date: 2026-10-14T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the great demo last week. We're ready to kick off a 90-day pilot next Monday, but our procurement cycle is slower than our engineering team's timeline. Can Redwood provision the pilot on an invoice-only basis for the first 90 days while we complete our internal PO setup?

What we can provide immediately: a signed SOW, W9, and a single-point procurement contact. We can supply a PO number once our vendor portal approval completes (target ~45 days).

Attachments: HorizonX_SOW.pdf (application/pdf), HorizonX_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

High level ask: invoice-only for up to $12,000 of consumption, Net-30 terms, PO to follow if we move to production after the pilot.

Please let me know what evidence or controls you need on our side to approve a temporary no-PO onboarding.

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of Strategic Programs
HorizonX Labs
lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot

Thanks Lisa — appreciate the prompt SOW and W9. Looping in Ben (AE) and Jonas (Head of Finance Ops) to confirm Redwood's temporary onboarding options.

Ben/jonas — HorizonX is asking for invoice-only for the pilot (up to $12k, Net-30). They will supply a PO once their portal is green. They're willing to sign the SOW and accept limited controls. Can finance support a 90-day invoice path with the following constraints?
- HorizonX must provide signed SOW and W9 (attached)
- A named procurement contact and acknowledgement that PO will be provided within 45 days
- Consumption cap hard-stop at $12k (billing alert + automatic service suspension)

If this is acceptable, I'll send the formal pilot addendum and a DocuSign link.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot

Thanks Marissa — and hi Lisa, great to be working with you. Quick context from my side: HorizonX is a target strategic account for Q4; engineering plans to evaluate both latency and throughput profiles over the pilot, so time-to-first-token matters. A 90-day invoice path will materially help their evaluation cadence.

From a commercial standpoint I'm comfortable with the constraints Marissa outlined. Proposal from AE side:
- Invoice-only for pilot period (90 days) with hard cap at $12k
- Require a signed pilot addendum (DocuSign) that includes: acceptance of Net-30 terms, agreement to provide PO within 45 days, and agreement that any usage over $12k will be paused until PO/exception is approved
- If the pilot converts, standard PO requirement for production will be enforced; we'll capture billing as prepaid or via PO at renewal

Lisa — if you can confirm the procurement contact and the target date for the PO, I will push the addendum today and notify our billing team to enable the account under the invoice-only flag.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot

Marissa/Ben/Lisa —

Operationally we can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding on the conditions below. This is a narrowly scoped exception and requires coordinated steps: 

1) Evidence we need from HorizonX BEFORE billing is enabled: signed SOW (received), completed W9 (received), procurement contact and target PO date (please confirm).
2) Signed pilot addendum (DocuSign) that enumerates the cap ($12k), Net-30, and automatic suspension behavior.
3) Billing controls we will put in place: billing alerts at 50% and 85% of cap, automatic suspend at 100% consumption, and a manual review if invoiced amount > $9k in a single month.
4) Internal approvals: this exception is approved by Finance Ops but is timeboxed to 90 days with no automatic renewals. Any extension requires elevated sign-off (Finance + Legal).

If HorizonX accepts these controls, please sign the addendum and I'll route to billing to enable the invoice-only onboarding. Also provide a HubSpot deal ID if you have one so we can attach the exception to the record.

Jonas Weber
Head, Finance Operations
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Mark Evans <mark.evans@horizonxlabs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary PO exemption for HorizonX Labs pilot

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear controls. We accept the conditions Jonas listed.

Procurement contact: Lisa Tran (lisa.tran@horizonxlabs.com)
Target PO delivery: 2026-11-28 (we expect portal approval by then)
HubSpot deal: HB-2026-0987 (Ben, looks like your team has it already)

We signed the DocuSign addendum (link below) and confirm we will adhere to the cap and provide the PO as soon as our vendor portal completes. Please proceed with enabling the invoice-only path and the billing alerts.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recap/ABCDEF123456

Best,
